single_most_valuable_next_cycle.title: Shared BharatAlpha Intelligence Layer + Automated Lookahead/Convergence CI Gate + 3-State RiskEngine Hardening
single_most_valuable_next_cycle.rationale: CYCLE-008 proved that BharatAlpha's #1 bottleneck is NOT a shortage of strategies or UI polish — it is (1) fragmented/drifting indicator & regime math across 4 duplicate codepaths, (2) only 3 committed Stage 1 archive dates & 0 unexposed holdout dates, and (3) uncalibrated confidence with no automated lookahead/convergence CI validator. Building the single-source-of-truth Intelligence Layer (F-04 + F-02 + F-05) with the automated bias/convergence CI gate (F-01) and clean-room 3-state RiskEngine upgrade (F-03) directly eliminates structural debt and establishes the prerequisite foundation for valid multi-month out-of-sample evaluation.
